method: Each window starts from a MuJoCo state. The world model independently predicts the next 1–50 transitions using the identical saved commands. Errors are measured against MuJoCo at each horizon; no state refresh occurs inside a window.
limits: Scripted shoulder movement, not a trained policy.
128 overlapping windows from 8 seeded trajectories, not 128 independent trials.
Reference trajectories include falling and ground-contact states. High-root subset means anchor root height >0.6 m; it does not guarantee stable standing.
Native MuJoCo WASM differs from the training Warp backend.
No training, throughput, SONIC-policy or physical-robot benchmark.
